subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw expose blocked Telegram and WhatsApp DM content to trusted pre-authorization hooks and make grouped DM allowlists a durable core/plugin contract?
rationale: This external feature changes admission-time privacy, plugin API, config shape, CLI behavior, and automatic hook loading; code review can verify safeguards but cannot choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve a focused contract
options.body: Fix the registry and patch scope, then accept the documented observation-only trusted hook and grouped allowlist contracts.

options.title: Use metadata-only audit events
options.body: Remove blocked message content from the event and expose only minimal sender, channel, reason, and timestamp metadata.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Keep blocked-message observation outside core and close or replace this PR with an external integration approach.

recommendation.title: Approve a focused contract
recommendation.body: Fix the registry and patch scope, then accept the documented observation-only trusted hook and grouped allowlist contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history makes Peter the strongest available cross-channel product and security-direction owner, with Vincent Koc as the adjacent hook/API owner.
